semantic_findings.result: The bound is on fullOddPreimages, whose list is exactly the literal canonical source fiber and is duplicate-free. Counts are coefficient words, not digit splittings or guessed carry-state witnesses.
Canonical positivity is a filter, hence can only decrease the duplicate-free exact path count; the checked odd_preimages_bound transfers the Fibonacci ceiling to every encoded target.

The all-nine dominance is established separately for the target normalized center digit. oddCenterMax selects ceiling/floor by center parity and m modulo six. full_fixed_center_maximum uses m=n+1, correctly excluding the width-one zero-center exception.

Replacing the first nine target symbol by eleven preserves initial path counts and forces source outer coefficient five; positivity therefore removes no candidate. sharpCenter is explicitly six for m modulo six below three, otherwise seven. Width one uses the positive source word [6].
Independent direct reduction gives sharpFamily lengths [1,1,1,2,3,4,7] at m=0..6; every Fin10 fixed-center count at m=1,3,6; the m=0 zero-center nonattainment case; and [6] mapping to [12].
The Sharp module alone quantifies encoded target parameters ss,v. The final OutputRange and Complete review separately verifies extension to all raw requested output lists.
